title: How checks are written
situation: The operator, 2026-10-15, confirmed after two read-backs: the workflow becomes intent-based delegation instead of a prescribed procedure. Checks were written for every cut by a check-writer and frozen.
decision: Every check runs on every pull request and nothing merges unless all pass. A builder writes the tests its change needs. When a story's risk calls for a check-writer, the checks binding its examples are written before the build by someone other than the builders and trusted only once seen to fail. A check binds the example's meaning, never wording the example did not fix; where a capability already defines correctness, the check delegates to it. Agents' behaviour is judged in use, never checked.
consequences: The check and check-writer concepts state this.
